name: Brook
description: A ultra clean Eleventy Blogging template

scripts.build: npm run test:project-frontmatter && npm run test:pages-cms && npm run clean && npm run clean-prod && ELEVENTY_ENV=production eleventy && gulp sass && gulp minify-css && gulp dist-assets && gulp prod-copy && npm run version:module-imports && gulp inject-min-css && gulp purgecss && gulp minify-html && gulp copy-CNAME && npm run build:podcast-cards && npm run build:og && npm run test:i18n:rendered
scripts.build:ci: USE_WEBP=true npm run build && npm run build:webp
scripts.build-dev: ELEVENTY_ENV=development eleventy && gulp dist-assets && gulp sass && npm run build:podcast-cards -- --dev-only && node scripts/validate-built-podcast-i18n.mjs --directory=dev
scripts.check:podcasts: npm run test:platform-pin && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:audit && npm run test:podcasts
scripts.test:podcast-show-deletion: node --test tests/podcast-admin-show-delete.test.mjs && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-show-delete.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-errors.js
scripts.test:podcast-admin-context: node --test tests/podcast-admin-directory-packet.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-distribution-disclosure.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-section-tabs.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-trace-contract.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-cdp-navigation.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-episode-context.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-show-context.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-show-selection.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-workflow-priority.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-workflow-target.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-workflow-navigation.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-deep-link.test.mjs tests/podcast-admin-processor-automation-copy.test.mjs tests/podcast-staging-turnstile.test.mjs && node --check scripts/lib/podcast-admin-trace-contract.mjs && node --check scripts/lib/podcast-admin-cdp-navigation.mjs && node --check scripts/lib/podcast-staging-turnstile.mjs && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-directory-packet.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-distribution-disclosure.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-section-tabs.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-episode-context.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-episode-context-setup.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-readiness-copy.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-show-context.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-show-selection.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-workflow-priority.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-workflow-target.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-workflow-navigation.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-deep-link.js && node --check src/js/podcast-admin-workflow-controller.js
scripts.test:podcasts: npm run test:i18n && npm run test:footer && node scripts/validate-podcast-accessibility.mjs && node scripts/validate-site-performance.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-shows.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-performance.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-episode-template.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-social-cards.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-player.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-transcript.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-chapters.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-clips.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-admin.mjs && node scripts/validate-datatype.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-member.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-checkout.mjs && node scripts/validate-hosting-headers.mjs && node scripts/run-podcast-tests.mjs && npm run check:podcast-modules
scripts.watch-dev: npm run build-dev && npm run sync
scripts.watch:server: npm run clean && npm run build-assets && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names assets,site "npm:sync" "npm:watch:all"
